verdict.rationale: The SDK documents per-tool-call approval gating that pauses the run and resumes from RunState, plus input/output guardrails. For sandboxing, it offers sandbox agents that run in isolated workspaces with manifest-defined files and selectable sandbox clients, and the hosted CodeInterpreterTool runs code in a sandboxed environment. Missing for 10: an explicit fine-grained permission model (per-tool scopes or allow/deny policies beyond approval prompts), detailed documentation of sandbox isolation guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
